s0301.literal: " An edict ordered that from now on military households need not pay.
s0301.idiomatic: An edict ordered that from now on military households need not pay.

s0302.literal: On bingzi day the Revenue Recovery Office was abolished.
s0302.idiomatic: On bingzi day the revenue recovery office was abolished.

s0303.literal: Famine in Shangdu and Taiyuan; more than thirty-eight thousand five hundred shi of land tax owed by commoners from the twelfth to the twenty-sixth year of Zhiyuan was remitted; envoys were dispatched together with the surveillance commission to relieve famine victims in Datong and Taiyuan, with grain issued per person for two or three months.
s0303.idiomatic: Famine struck Shangdu and Taiyuan; more than 38,500 shi of land tax owed by commoners from the twelfth to the twenty-sixth year of Zhiyuan was remitted; envoys were dispatched with the surveillance commission to relieve famine victims in Datong and Taiyuan, with grain issued per person for two or three months.

s0304.literal: Because of association with Sangge's faction, Yangzhou Route darughachi Suoluowusi was dismissed.
s0304.idiomatic: Because of association with Sangge's faction, Yangzhou Route darughachi Suoluowusi was dismissed.

s0305.literal: Officials were dispatched to re-verify the poor of Shuidada and Xianping and provide relief.
s0305.idiomatic: Officials were dispatched to re-verify the poor of Shuidada and Xianping and provide relief.

s0306.literal: On dingchou day Right Director of the Heir Apparent's Household Wanze was made right chancellor of the Ministry secretariat, and Hanlin academician and chief director Buqumu was made grand councillor; an edict announced this throughout the realm.
s0306.idiomatic: On dingchou day Right Director of the Heir Apparent's Household Wanze was made right chancellor of the ministry secretariat, and Hanlin academician and chief director Buqumu was made grand councillor; an edict announced this throughout the realm.

s0307.literal: Polished rice from Lienuan was distributed to relieve the poor.
s0307.idiomatic: Polished rice from Lienuan was distributed to relieve the poor.

s0308.literal: On jimao day officials bearing incense were dispatched to pray at the Central Peak, South Sea, and Huai River.
s0308.idiomatic: On jimao day officials bearing incense were dispatched to pray at the Central Peak, South Sea, and Huai River.

s0309.literal: The Pacification Commissioner's Headquarters of Jinchi and other places was established.
s0309.idiomatic: The pacification commissioner's headquarters of Jinchi and other places was established.

s0310.literal: Two thousand tiger guards from Shangdu were ordered to farm garrison fields; the government supplied oxen, implements, and farm tools, using twenty thousand ingots of notes.
s0310.idiomatic: 2,000 tiger guards from Shangdu were ordered to farm garrison fields; the government supplied oxen, implements, and farm tools, using 20,000 ingots of notes.

s0311.literal: Because the territory under the Qujing Pacification Commission of Yunnan was broad and popular sentiment was not yet settled, the Qujing and other places Pacification Commission and Military Ten-thousand-household Headquarters were established to garrison it; on xinsi day the Eight Tribes of Luodian in the Huguang branch secretariat was again placed under the Sichuan branch secretariat.
s0311.idiomatic: Because the territory under the Qujing Pacification Commission of Yunnan was broad and popular sentiment was not yet settled, the Qujing and other places Pacification Commission and Military Ten-thousand-household Headquarters were established to garrison it; on xinsi day the Eight Tribes of Luodian in the Huguang branch secretariat was again placed under the Sichuan branch secretariat.

s0312.literal: On renwu day, because Sangge had obstructed the censorate and also beat an investigating censor, Censor-in-chief Yuerlu was ordered to investigate.
s0312.idiomatic: On renwu day, because Sangge had obstructed the censorate and also beaten an investigating censor, Censor-in-chief Yuerlu was ordered to investigate.

s0313.literal: On guimou day the moon transgressed Left Law.
s0313.idiomatic: On guimou day the moon transgressed Left Law.

s0314.literal: The imperial procession proceeded to Shangdu; that day it halted at Dukou, and the censorate together with officials of the Central and Ministry secretariats were again summoned to debate Sangge's crimes.
s0314.idiomatic: The imperial procession proceeded to Shangdu; that day it halted at Dukou, and the censorate together with officials of the central and ministry secretariats were again summoned to debate Sangge's crimes.

s0315.literal: The Lanwei Bureau was again placed under the Xuanzheng Court.
s0315.idiomatic: The Lanwei Bureau was again placed under the Xuanzheng Court.

s0316.literal: An edict forbade obstructing or harassing the Shandong Transport Commission's revenue quotas.
s0316.idiomatic: An edict forbade obstructing or harassing the Shandong transport commission's revenue quotas.

s0317.literal: On jiashen day Venus transgressed the Pleiades.
s0317.idiomatic: On jiashen day Venus transgressed the Pleiades.

s0318.literal: The Jiang-Huai branch secretariat was ordered to audit the Jiangnan revenues and grain under Shabuding's supervision of the Heir Apparent's Household.
s0318.idiomatic: The Jiang-Huai branch secretariat was ordered to audit the Jiangnan revenues and grain under Shabuding's supervision of the Heir Apparent's Household.

s0319.literal: On yiyou day branch privy councils were established in Jiang-Huai, Huguang, Jiangxi, Sichuan, and other places; an edict announced this throughout the realm: Jiang-Huai was to be administered from Guangde Army, Huguang from Yue Prefecture, Jiangxi from Ting Prefecture, and Sichuan from Jiading.
s0319.idiomatic: On yiyou day branch privy councils were established in Jiang-Huai, Huguang, Jiangxi, Sichuan, and other places; an edict announced this throughout the realm: Jiang-Huai was to be administered from Guangde Army, Huguang from Yue Prefecture, Jiangxi from Ting Prefecture, and Sichuan from Jiading.

s0320.literal: On bingxu day an edict ordered: "The Surveillance Commissions for Punishment and Investigation are renamed Rectification and Anti-Corruption Surveillance Commissions; each circuit still has eight officials, aside from two commissioners remaining at headquarters to oversee the whole circuit, the remaining six divide among the subordinate jurisdictions; civil cases, revenues and grain, and official malfeasance are all entrusted to them; at year's end the secretariat and censorate will dispatch officials to assess their effectiveness.
s0320.idiomatic: On bingxu day an edict ordered, "The surveillance commissions for punishment and investigation are renamed rectification and anti-corruption surveillance commissions; each circuit still has eight officials — aside from two commissioners remaining at headquarters to oversee the whole circuit, the remaining six divide among the subordinate jurisdictions; civil cases, revenues and grain, and official malfeasance are all entrusted to them; at year's end the secretariat and censorate will dispatch officials to assess their effectiveness.

s0321.literal: " Academy of Scholarly Worthies grand academician He Rongzu was made right vice chancellor of the Ministry secretariat, and Academy academician He Sheng was made associate administrator of the Ministry secretariat.
s0321.idiomatic: Academy of Scholarly Worthies grand academician He Rongzu was made right vice chancellor of the ministry secretariat, and academy academician He Sheng was made associate administrator of the ministry secretariat.

s0322.literal: An edict ordered the Jiang-Huai branch secretariat to dispatch five hundred Mongol troops and one thousand Han troops to follow the Prince of Zhennan in garrisoning Yangzhou.
s0322.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Jiang-Huai branch secretariat to dispatch 500 Mongol troops and 1,000 Han troops to follow the Prince of Zhennan in garrisoning Yangzhou.

s0323.literal: Hejian Route transport commissioner Zhang Yong was arrested, and officials were again dispatched to audit the matter.
s0323.idiomatic: Hejian Route transport commissioner Zhang Yong was arrested, and officials were again dispatched to audit the matter.

s0324.literal: On dinghai day barracks were built on the south side of the palace city to house palace-guard troops.
s0324.idiomatic: On dinghai day barracks were built on the south side of the palace city to house palace-guard troops.

s0325.literal: Huguang Yaoshumu was arrested and brought to the capital; on wuzi day Yaoshumu's household property was registered, with gold totaling four thousand liang.
s0325.idiomatic: Huguang Yaoshumu was arrested and brought to the capital; on wuzi day Yaoshumu's household property was registered, with gold totaling 4,000 liang.

s0326.literal: On xinmao day Prince Timur Buqa was enfeoffed as Prince of Suyuan and granted a seal.
s0326.idiomatic: On xinmao day Prince Timur Buqa was enfeoffed as Prince of Suyuan and granted a seal.

s0327.literal: On renchen day rain damaged the first chamber of the Imperial Ancestral Temple; the spirit tablets were moved to a side hall.
s0327.idiomatic: On renchen day rain damaged the first chamber of the Imperial Ancestral Temple; the spirit tablets were moved to a side hall.

s0328.literal: On guisi day Sangge's household property was registered.
s0328.idiomatic: On guisi day Sangge's household property was registered.

s0329.literal: Branch secretariat and mobile censorate officials were ordered to distribute grain and relieve famine victims in Jixi of Huizhou and Lin'an, Yuhang, Yuqian, Changhua, and Xincheng counties of Hangzhou.
s0329.idiomatic: Branch secretariat and mobile censorate officials were ordered to distribute grain and relieve famine victims in Jixi of Huizhou and Lin'an, Yuhang, Yuqian, Changhua, and Xincheng counties of Hangzhou.

s0330.literal: The Jiang-Huai branch secretariat associate administrator Yan Gongnan was ordered to rectify abuses in the salt laws.
s0330.idiomatic: The Jiang-Huai branch secretariat associate administrator Yan Gongnan was ordered to rectify abuses in the salt laws.

s0331.literal: On dingyou day an edict added honorific titles to the peaks, streams, and Four Seas; officials were dispatched separately to each shrine to announce and report.
s0331.idiomatic: On dingyou day an edict added honorific titles to the peaks, streams, and Four Seas; officials were dispatched separately to each shrine to announce and report.

s0332.literal: Third month, jihai new moon: famine in Zhending, Hejian, Baoding, and Pingluan; Pingyang and Taiyuan were especially severe; sixty-seven thousand households of people migrated elsewhere for food, and three hundred seventy-one died of famine.
s0332.idiomatic: Third month, jihai new moon: famine in Zhending, Hejian, Baoding, and Pingluan; Pingyang and Taiyuan were especially severe; 67,000 households migrated elsewhere for food, and 371 died of famine.

s0333.literal: Bajiyou, brother-in-law of Sangge's wife, was Yan South Pacification Commissioner; for accepting bribes and accumulating illicit gains he was executed.
s0333.idiomatic: Bajiyou, brother-in-law of Sangge's wife, was Yan South Pacification Commissioner; for accepting bribes and accumulating illicit gains he was executed.

s0334.literal: Sangge's stele commemorating his administration was toppled.
s0334.idiomatic: Sangge's stele commemorating his administration was toppled.

s0335.literal: Famine in Taiyuan; a strict liquor prohibition was imposed.
s0335.idiomatic: Famine in Taiyuan; a strict liquor prohibition was imposed.

s0336.literal: On dingwei day the moon transgressed the Maid.
s0336.idiomatic: On dingwei day the moon transgressed the Maid.

s0337.literal: On jiyou day the moon transgressed Right Law.
s0337.idiomatic: On jiyou day the moon transgressed Right Law.

s0338.literal: On gengxu day the moon transgressed the upper chancellor of the eastern wall of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
s0338.idiomatic: On gengxu day the moon transgressed the upper chancellor of the eastern wall of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

s0339.literal: On jiayin day flooding in Changde Route; twenty-three thousand nine hundred shi of land tax was remitted.
s0339.idiomatic: On jiayin day flooding in Changde Route; 23,900 shi of land tax was remitted.

s0340.literal: On yimao day Venus transgressed the Five Chariots.
s0340.idiomatic: On yimao day Venus transgressed the Five Chariots.

s0341.literal: Yiermawu and others among Nayan's followers, together with five hundred Jurchen troops, pursued and killed more than one thousand surrendered commoners; Tohai was ordered to lead one thousand troops to pacify them.
s0341.idiomatic: Yiermawu and others among Nayan's followers, together with 500 Jurchen troops, pursued and killed more than 1,000 surrendered commoners; Tohai was ordered to lead 1,000 troops to pacify them.

s0342.literal: On xinyou day fifty households of Mongol post-station families at Lianzhan suffered famine; grain was provided for three months.
s0342.idiomatic: On xinyou day 50 households of Mongol post-station families at Lianzhan suffered famine; grain was provided for three months.

s0343.literal: Palace-guard troops were dispatched to construct the Zitan Hall.
s0343.idiomatic: Palace-guard troops were dispatched to construct the Zitan Hall.

s0344.literal: On renxu day Gansu branch secretariat right vice chancellor Cui Yu was made right vice chancellor of the Central Secretariat.
s0344.idiomatic: On renxu day Gansu branch secretariat right vice chancellor Cui Yu was made right vice chancellor of the central secretariat.

s0345.literal: Mo Guolin of Nandan Prefecture came to audience; Guolin was appointed pacification commissioner and granted a three-pearl tiger tally.
s0345.idiomatic: Mo Guolin of Nandan Prefecture came to audience; Guolin was appointed pacification commissioner and granted a three-pearl tiger tally.

s0346.literal: Famine in five routes including Hangzhou and Pingjiang; grain was distributed for relief, and prohibitions on lakes, reeds, and fish were relaxed.
s0346.idiomatic: Famine in five routes including Hangzhou and Pingjiang; grain was distributed for relief, and prohibitions on lakes, reeds, and fish were relaxed.

s0347.literal: Five routes including Liyang, Taiping, Huizhou, Guangde, and Zhenjiang also suffered famine and were relieved as at Hangzhou.
s0347.idiomatic: Five routes including Liyang, Taiping, Huizhou, Guangde, and Zhenjiang also suffered famine and were relieved as at Hangzhou.

s0348.literal: Famine in Wuping Route; the people were distressed by bandits and military levies; last year's land tax was remitted.
s0348.idiomatic: Famine in Wuping Route; the people were distressed by bandits and military levies; last year's land tax was remitted.

s0349.literal: For all prefectures and commanderies whose fields had suffered disaster, rent was entirely remitted; where no disaster had occurred, five-tenths was remitted.
s0349.idiomatic: For all prefectures and commanderies whose fields had suffered disaster, rent was entirely remitted; where no disaster had occurred, five-tenths was remitted.

s0350.literal: The Ganzhou Transport Commission was abolished.
s0350.idiomatic: The Ganzhou transport commission was abolished.

s0351.literal: Powerful families of Jiang-Huai often bribed influential officials to become prefectural and county clerks and runners, sheltering their households; when levies and corvée fell due, only poor commoners bore them; an edict ordered the Jiang-Huai branch secretariat strictly to forbid this.
s0351.idiomatic: Powerful families of Jiang-Huai often bribed influential officials to become prefectural and county clerks and runners, sheltering their households; when levies and corvée fell due, only poor commoners bore them; an edict ordered the Jiang-Huai branch secretariat strictly to forbid this.

s0352.literal: Famine victims in Liaoyang and Wuping were relieved, and hunting prohibitions were relaxed.
s0352.idiomatic: Famine victims in Liaoyang and Wuping were relieved, and hunting prohibitions were relaxed.

s0353.literal: Summer, fourth month, jisi day: slaughter of female sheep was forbidden.
s0353.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, jisi day: slaughter of female sheep was forbidden.

s0354.literal: On jiaxu day an edict ordered that chief and deputy officials of all routes, prefectures, subprefectures, and counties concurrently administer the aolu of all armies.
s0354.idiomatic: On jiaxu day an edict ordered that chief and deputy officials of all routes, prefectures, subprefectures, and counties concurrently administer the aolu of all armies.

s0355.literal: Because of the earthquake, corvée for palace-guard households registered in Wuping this year was remitted.
s0355.idiomatic: Because of the earthquake, corvée for palace-guard households registered in Wuping this year was remitted.

s0356.literal: One Kipchak Guard intendant was added, to be filled by a Han Chinese; this was not to serve as a precedent for other posts.
s0356.idiomatic: One Kipchak Guard intendant was added, to be filled by a Han Chinese; this was not to serve as a precedent for other posts.

s0357.literal: On gengchen day prohibitions on birds and fish in Hangzhou's West Lake were relaxed, allowing commoners to net and catch them.
s0357.idiomatic: On gengchen day prohibitions on birds and fish in Hangzhou's West Lake were relaxed, allowing commoners to net and catch them.

s0358.literal: On bingxu day an edict ordered that all who repaid ortogh silver should do so in notes as the standard.
s0358.idiomatic: On bingxu day an edict ordered that all who repaid ortogh silver should do so in notes as the standard.

s0359.literal: On yimao day Jupiter transgressed the Ghost asterism.
s0359.idiomatic: On yimao day Jupiter transgressed the Ghost asterism.

s0360.literal: Rice from Shabuding and others was used to relieve famine victims in Jiangnan.
s0360.idiomatic: Rice from Shabuding and others was used to relieve famine victims in Jiangnan.

s0361.literal: Zhu Qing and Zhang Xuan were summoned to court.
s0361.idiomatic: Zhu Qing and Zhang Xuan were summoned to court.

s0362.literal: On gengyin day the Directorate-General was merged into the Xuanzheng Court.
s0362.idiomatic: On gengyin day the directorate-general was merged into the Xuanzheng Court.

s0363.literal: Because of the note policy, Ye Li was recalled to the capital.
s0363.idiomatic: Because of the note policy, Ye Li was recalled to the capital.

s0364.literal: On yimao day the Huguang branch privy council was moved to administer from Ezhou.
s0364.idiomatic: On yimao day the Huguang branch privy council was moved to administer from Ezhou.

s0365.literal: On bingshen day three thousand shi of rice was distributed to relieve famine victims in Kuolejisi.
s0365.idiomatic: On bingshen day 3,000 shi of rice was distributed to relieve famine victims in Kuolejisi.

s0366.literal: Fifth month, wuxu day: Jiangxi branch privy council vice director Ali was summoned to court, and the rank of the Seal-and-Pendant Directorate was raised to third grade.
s0366.idiomatic: Fifth month, wuxu day: Jiangxi branch privy council vice director Ali was summoned to court, and the rank of the Seal-and-Pendant Directorate was raised to third grade.

s0367.literal: Tuotuo, Talihai, and Huxin were dispatched to investigate Buddhist official Yang Lianzhenjia and others for embezzling official property.
s0367.idiomatic: Tuotuo, Talihai, and Huxin were dispatched to investigate Buddhist official Yang Lianzhenjia and others for embezzling official property.

s0368.literal: Associate administrator Lian Xishu was made right vice chancellor of the Huguang and other places branch secretariat and director of the Haibei and Hainan Circuit Pacification Commission; Chen Zhongda, Haibei and Hainan Circuit pacification commissioner and Qiongzhou pacification commissioner, was made director of the Haibei and Hainan Circuit Pacification Commission; Huguang branch secretariat left and right secretariat bureau director Buyansusi, Biebashili vice marshal, and Wang Xin vice marshal were all made vice directors of the Haibei and Hainan Circuit Pacification Commission; all were granted tiger tallies and led two thousand two hundred men to campaign against the Li tribes; subordinates were all recruited and appointed by Zhongda.
s0368.idiomatic: Associate administrator Lian Xishu was made right vice chancellor of the Huguang and other places branch secretariat and director of the Haibei and Hainan Circuit Pacification Commission; Chen Zhongda, Haibei and Hainan Circuit pacification commissioner and Qiongzhou pacification commissioner, was made director of the Haibei and Hainan Circuit Pacification Commission; Huguang branch secretariat left and right secretariat bureau director Buyansusi, Biebashili vice marshal, and Wang Xin vice marshal were all made vice directors of the Haibei and Hainan Circuit Pacification Commission; all were granted tiger tallies and led 2,200 men to campaign against the Li tribes; subordinates were all recruited and appointed by Zhongda.

s0369.literal: The Pacification Commissioner's Headquarters of the Left and Right Rivers was established.
s0369.idiomatic: The pacification commissioner's headquarters of the Left and Right Rivers was established.

s0370.literal: On renyin day the moon transgressed the Lesser People.
s0370.idiomatic: On renyin day the moon transgressed the Lesser People.

s0371.literal: The Jiang-Huai branch privy council was moved to administer from Jiankang.
s0371.idiomatic: The Jiang-Huai branch privy council was moved to administer from Jiankang.

s0372.literal: On jiachen day Central Secretariat officials Maishuding and Cui Yu said: "While Sangge held power for four years, many officials advanced through bribes and his kin and associates all received important posts; they did nothing but deceive the throne and fleece the people; the two secretariats should be ordered strictly to investigate and all should be dismissed to commoner status.
s0372.idiomatic: On jiachen day central secretariat officials Maishuding and Cui Yu said, "While Sangge held power for four years, many officials advanced through bribes and his kin and associates all received important posts; they did nothing but deceive the throne and fleece the people; the two secretariats should be ordered strictly to investigate and all should be dismissed to commoner status.

s0374.literal: Yaoshumu, through Sangge's wife's faction, had been Huguang branch secretariat grand councillor; now for dozens of unlawful acts he was ordered shackled and sent to Huguang province for execution.
s0374.idiomatic: Yaoshumu, through Sangge's wife's faction, had been Huguang branch secretariat grand councillor; now for dozens of unlawful acts he was ordered shackled and sent to Huguang province for execution.

s0375.literal: On xinhai day, because of famine in Taiyuan and Hangzhou, this year's land tax was remitted.
s0375.idiomatic: On xinhai day, because of famine in Taiyuan and Hangzhou, this year's land tax was remitted.

s0376.literal: One Hedong Circuit pacification commissioner was added.
s0376.idiomatic: One Hedong Circuit pacification commissioner was added.

s0377.literal: Heir Apparent Tutor Liu Yin was summoned;
s0377.idiomatic: Heir Apparent Tutor Liu Yin was summoned;

s0378.literal: Yin had formerly been heir apparent tutor but left because of his stepmother's illness; now his mother had died and he was summoned as academy academician, but he did not accept.
s0378.idiomatic: Yin had formerly been heir apparent tutor but left because of his stepmother's illness; now his mother had died and he was summoned as academy academician, but he did not accept.

s0379.literal: Tuotuo, Talihai, Huxin, and others were dismissed from auditing Buddhist officials' revenues and grain.
s0379.idiomatic: Tuotuo, Talihai, Huxin, and others were dismissed from auditing Buddhist officials' revenues and grain.

s0380.literal: The Jiangnan six tribute offices' annual submission of cotton was abolished.
s0380.idiomatic: The Jiangnan six tribute offices' annual submission of cotton was abolished.

s0381.literal: Gongchang had formerly had only a commander headquarters; Sangge specially promoted it to a pacification commission, with his younger brother Damaladas as commissioner; when Sangge fell, fearing execution he killed himself; now the commander headquarters was restored.
s0381.idiomatic: Gongchang had formerly had only a commander headquarters; Sangge specially promoted it to a pacification commission, with his younger brother Damaladas as commissioner; when Sangge fell, fearing execution he killed himself; now the commander headquarters was restored.

s0382.literal: The Rare Treasures and Imperial Belt treasuries were added, of rank equivalent to fifth grade, each with one intendant, commissioner, and vice-commissioner.
s0382.idiomatic: The Rare Treasures and Imperial Belt treasuries were added, of rank equivalent to fifth grade, each with one intendant, commissioner, and vice-commissioner.

s0383.literal: Thirty-seven redundant officials inside and outside the court were reduced.
s0383.idiomatic: 37 redundant officials inside and outside the court were reduced.

s0384.literal: Grape-wine rooms and women's workshops were built within the palace city.
s0384.idiomatic: Grape-wine rooms and women's workshops were built within the palace city.

s0385.literal: An edict ordered Sangge imprisoned and interrogated for his crimes, and his associates Yaoshumu, Bajiyou, and others executed.
s0385.idiomatic: An edict ordered Sangge imprisoned and interrogated for his crimes, and his associates Yaoshumu, Bajiyou, and others executed.

s0386.literal: Troops were dispatched to block the Huanghuo'eryue river channels, repair fortresses, and order Mongol garrison troops to farm fields in the valleys to guard against raiders.
s0386.idiomatic: Troops were dispatched to block the Huanghuo'eryue river channels, repair fortresses, and order Mongol garrison troops to farm fields in the valleys to guard against raiders.

s0387.literal: On guichou day the Ministry secretariat was abolished and all its affairs merged into the Central Secretariat; Right Chancellor and Right Director of the Heir Apparent's Household Wanze was changed to right chancellor of the Central Secretariat; Grand Councillors Maishuding and Buqumu were both made grand councillors of the Central Secretariat; Right Vice Chancellor He Rongzu was made right vice chancellor of the Central Secretariat; Left Vice Chancellor Ma Shao was made left vice chancellor of the Central Secretariat; Associate Administrators He Sheng and Gao Zhu were both made associate administrators of the Central Secretariat;
s0387.idiomatic: On guichou day the ministry secretariat was abolished and all its affairs merged into the central secretariat; Right Chancellor and Right Director of the Heir Apparent's Household Wanze was changed to right chancellor of the central secretariat; Grand Councillors Maishuding and Buqumu were both made grand councillors of the central secretariat; Right Vice Chancellor He Rongzu was made right vice chancellor of the central secretariat; Left Vice Chancellor Ma Shao was made left vice chancellor of the central secretariat; Associate Administrators He Sheng and Gao Zhu were both made associate administrators of the central secretariat;

s0388.literal: Left Chancellor of the Eastern Campaign Ministry secretariat and imperial son-in-law, Goryeo King Wang Chun, was made left chancellor of the Eastern Campaign Central Secretariat.
s0388.idiomatic: Left Chancellor of the Eastern Campaign ministry secretariat and imperial son-in-law, Goryeo King Wang Chun, was made left chancellor of the Eastern Campaign central secretariat.

s0389.literal: The Dadu note-burning depot was abolished and the former system restored: worn notes in each route were to be burned under branch secretariat supervision.
s0389.idiomatic: The Dadu note-burning depot was abolished and the former system restored: worn notes in each route were to be burned under branch secretariat supervision.

s0390.literal: The Ministry of Revenue Accounts Bureau and Ministry of Works Projects Bureau were added, of rank upper seventh grade.
s0390.idiomatic: The ministry of revenue accounts bureau and ministry of works projects bureau were added, of rank upper seventh grade.

s0391.literal: On jiayin day the moon transgressed the Ox.
s0391.idiomatic: On jiayin day the moon transgressed the Ox.

s0392.literal: Famine victims at post stations in Shangdu, Huanzhou, Yulin, Changping, Wuping, Kuanhe, Xuande, Xizhan, Jurchen, and other stations were relieved.
s0392.idiomatic: Famine victims at post stations in Shangdu, Huanzhou, Yulin, Changping, Wuping, Kuanhe, Xuande, Xizhan, Jurchen, and other stations were relieved.

s0393.literal: On yimao day all government affairs were entrusted to the Central Secretariat, and envoys were again dispatched to announce this throughout the realm.
s0393.idiomatic: On yimao day all government affairs were entrusted to the central secretariat, and envoys were again dispatched to announce this throughout the realm.

s0394.literal: An edict forbade those who had lost revenues and grain to use pretexts to go to the capital.
s0394.idiomatic: An edict forbade those who had lost revenues and grain to use pretexts to go to the capital.

s0395.literal: On dingsi day two white pagodas were built, each eleven chi high, to house the incantation masters Duosixingji and seven others.
s0395.idiomatic: On dingsi day two white pagodas were built, each 11 chi high, to house the incantation masters Duosixingji and seven others.

s0396.literal: He Rongzu compiled ten matters — public regulations, governing the people, suppressing bandits, managing finances, and the like — into one book titled Regulations of the Zhiyuan Era; an order directed that it be carved on blocks and issued, for all offices to observe.
s0396.idiomatic: He Rongzu compiled ten matters — public regulations, governing the people, suppressing bandits, managing finances, and the like — into one book titled Regulations of the Zhiyuan Era; an order directed that it be carved on blocks and issued, for all offices to observe.

s0397.literal: Sangge had once taken Liu Bingzhong's fields because he had no son; his wife Lady Dou said Bingzhong had once raised his nephew Lanzang as heir; an edict ordered one hundred qing of land returned.
s0397.idiomatic: Sangge had once taken Liu Bingzhong's fields because he had no son; his wife Lady Dou said Bingzhong had once raised his nephew Lanzang as heir; an edict ordered 100 qing of land returned.

s0398.literal: On jiwei day Mendachen was again made censor-in-chief and directed mobile censorate affairs.
s0398.idiomatic: On jiwei day Mendachen was again made censor-in-chief and directed mobile censorate affairs.

s0399.literal: Goryeo King Wang Chun requested that his son Seon be made heir; an edict established Seon as Goryeo heir apparent, granted him specially advanced pillar of state rank, and bestowed a silver seal.
s0399.idiomatic: Goryeo King Wang Chun requested that his son Seon be made heir; an edict established Seon as Goryeo heir apparent, granted him specially advanced pillar of state rank, and bestowed a silver seal.

s0400.literal: Sixth month, dingmao new moon: Mongols returning to Muslim lands as merchants were forbidden.
s0400.idiomatic: Sixth month, dingmao new moon: Mongols returning to Muslim lands as merchants were forbidden.
